exercises.title: AI/ML 1 — which kind of requirement?
exercises.problemHtml:
AI/ML systems need new kinds of requirements: data (quantity, quality, coverage, labelling, freshness), model performance (metrics with thresholds), fairness (no large differences across groups), explainability (justify a decision), monitoring and drift (retraining triggers) and human-in-the-loop / fallback (what happens at low confidence). Classify the requirements of an AI that triages X-ray images.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hệ AI/ML cần thêm các loại yêu cầu mới. Phân loại yêu cầu của AI phân loại ảnh X-quang.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

   - r4.k: Explainability
   - r5.k: Monitoring and drift

o.s: The system shall mark each uploaded chest X-ray as "normal" or "needs review".
The training set shall contain at least 40,000 labelled X-rays from at least 6 hospitals.
Recall for "needs review" shall be at least 0.97 on the held-out test set.
Recall shall not differ by more than 2 percentage points between patients over and under 60.
For each "needs review" result, the system shall highlight the image region that most influenced the decision.
Recall shall be measured monthly on newly labelled images; a drop of more than 3 points shall trigger a retraining review.
When the model confidence is below 0.70, the image shall be sent to a radiologist instead of being auto-classified.

exercises.title: AI/ML 2 — choose the metric that matches the cost of errors
exercises.problemHtml:
Precision = TP ÷ (TP + FP): of the cases flagged positive, how many really are. Recall = TP ÷ (TP + FN): of the real positives, how many were caught. Choose the metric that matches the cost of each error type. Accuracy can hide class imbalance.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Precision = TP ÷ (TP + FP). Recall = TP ÷ (TP + FN). Chọn chỉ số khớp chi phí lỗi. Accuracy có thể che mất mất cân bằng lớp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: AI/ML 3 — check a model against its requirements
exercises.problemHtml:
Model requirements for an X-ray triage model: MP-1 precision ≥ req.minPrecision; MP-2 recall ≥ req.minRecall; FR-1 (fairness) the recall of every group differs from the overall recall by at most req.maxGap. Write function evaluate(results, req) where results is an array of { group, actual, predicted } (booleans: true = "needs review"). Return { precision, recall, groupRecall: { [group]: number }, passed: [ids], failed: [ids] } — numbers rounded to 3 decimals, ids among "MP-1", "MP-2", "FR-1" in that order. A metric whose denominator is 0 counts as 0. Groups with no actual positives are ignored for FR-1 (but still listed with recall 0).

Requirements

  • Compare after rounding to 3 decimals.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Viết evaluate(results, req) tính precision, recall tổng, recall theo nhóm, và cho biết yêu cầu MP-1 (precision), MP-2 (recall), FR-1 (chênh recall nhóm so với tổng ≤ maxGap) đạt hay trượt. Làm tròn 3 chữ số; mẫu số 0 ⇒ 0; nhóm không có ca dương thật bị bỏ qua khi xét FR-1.

Yêu cầu

  • So sánh sau khi làm tròn 3 chữ số.
hintsJson: Đếm TP, FP, FN; mẫu số 0 ⇒ 0.
Nhóm hoá theo group, tính recall từng nhóm, so với recall tổng.

exercises.title: AI/ML 4 — turn an AI wish into requirements
exercises.problemHtml:
Stakeholder: "Build an AI that reads handwritten prescriptions and fills in the medicines automatically." Write AIREQ with six keys — functional, data, performance, fallback, monitoring, fairness — each one requirement sentence starting with "The system shall" or "The training data shall" / "The model shall". Each non-functional one must contain a number; fallback must mention a confidence threshold and a human (pharmacist/doctor); performance must name a metric (precision, recall, accuracy, F1) and a test set.

Requirements

  • No vague words like "accurate enough", "good", "smart".
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Biến mong muốn "AI đọc đơn thuốc viết tay rồi tự điền thuốc" thành 6 yêu cầu: functional, data, performance, fallback, monitoring, fairness; mỗi câu bắt đầu "The system shall" / "The training data shall" / "The model shall"; yêu cầu phi chức năng có số; fallback nêu ngưỡng độ tin cậy và người (dược sĩ/bác sĩ); performance nêu chỉ số và tập test.

Yêu cầu

  • Không dùng từ mơ hồ như "accurate enough", "good", "smart".

examplesJson.output: The system shall send a prescription line to a pharmacist for manual entry when the extraction confidence is below 0.85.
